hotel_name: Hotel Palm Grand - Naraina New Delhi

positive_snippets:
I recently got married on 27th October 2025, and we booked Hotel PALM Grand, Naraina, New Delhi for three days — 25th for our Engagement, 26th for Haldi & Mehendi, and 27th for the Wedding, with checkout on the 28th.

We had booked 20 rooms, and I must say the overall experience was exceptional. The breakfast, lunch, and event food were all fresh, delicious, and beautifully managed throughout our stay.

A special mention to Mr. Rajeev, the manager of PALM Grand Hotel, for his outstanding coordination and support. The reception team — Manisha and Abhishek — were extremely polite, professional, and helpful at every step.

Amazing service, great room service, very cooperative staff, and absolutely tasty food made our most important days even more memorable. Highly recommended for weddings and events!

Booked this property for three days for my sister's wedding. I am amazed by the service and hospitality.  I really felt like we were at home. All the staff took good care of our family. All the functions held at this hotel were very well organized. Special thanks to Mr. Rajiv for providing hospitality like a family member. I would also like to comment on the food; the quality is top-notch—so delicious. Thank you to all the staff. I will definitely book this property again.
negative_snippets:
Our car window was broken and things were stolen while we were attending a family event there. Since it was vallet parking and we were not aware where our car was parked as they don't have designated parking, it should have been the accountability of staff.
They didn't take any accountability and told us such crimes happens and vallet parking is always at owner's risk. It ruined the mood of our entire family. What should be a happy and memorable day turned into a horrible memory. All because of negligence and unaccountable behaviour of their staff.

Hotel Palm Grand did a decent job for my friend's wedding. The hotel ambiance was nice. I only had the starters, so can't comment on the full menu. Seems suitable for small functions; might not scale up for bigger events."
